title: Control flow [switch (why break;)]
description:
## Why break;?
---
You may be thinking 'Why do i need to put break after each switch case?'
This is because somthing called _**Fallthrough**_. Fallthrough means that switch will keep going on to the next statement till it hits a break statement.
---
## Assignment:
What would be the output of this switch statement:
```ts
const thing: number = 124;
switch(thing) {
    case 23:
        console.log("Case 1!")
    case 124:
        console.log("Case 2!");
    default:
        console.log("Default case!");
}
